Name: lanterncat's Prospurrity for 1.6
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
Mod permission is open for this one, so I present lanterncat's Prospurrity (found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4253]here[/url]) updated for SDV 1.6. Credit for the original mod goes to lanterncat

These kitties live in a barn and, with a milk pail, produce a variety of items:

Himalayans produce fish bags, which contain, you guessed it, a fish! Put the bag in the included Aquarium to retrieve them
Torties produce fried eels and lucky lunches﻿
Russian Blues produce tickets that can be used in the included Sweet Dispenser to get a variety of cat-themed sweets
Magical cats produce coffee and espresso

There is also an ice cream maker that produces cat-themed ice cream treats using sugar as a starter. Recipes for the craftables can be found at Marnie's.

Enjoy!
